# hpe_morpheus_os_type_image (Data Source)



Looks up an OS type image by matching a virtual image name within a given OS type. This is useful for finding the image mapping ID needed when provisioning instances for a specific operating system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_os_type_image" "example" {
  os_type_id         = 1
  virtual_image_name = "Example Image"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `os_type_id` (Number) The ID of the os type to search for the image
- `virtual_image_name` (String) The name of the virtual image

### Read-Only

- `cloud_id` (Number) The cloud that is attached to the os type image
- `cloud_type_id` (Number) The cloud type of the os type image
- `id` (Number) Morpheus ID of the os type image
- `provision_type_id` (Number) The Provision Type of the os type image
- `tenant_id` (Number) The tenant associated with the os type image
- `virtual_image_id` (Number) The id of the virtual image
